VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report is the only evidence, and it is internally incoherent: a token-refresh race condition would not be caused by "float-precision drift in the summation" or fixed by switching to "integer cents"—that describes a monetary/accounting bug, not a concurrency issue. No CI log, diff, or independent artifact substantiates the claim, so the acceptance criteria cannot be confirmed.
